theme: Be Strong and of a Good Courage
verse: Have not I commanded thee? Be strong and of a good courage; be not afraid, neither be thou dismayed: for the LORD thy God is with thee whithersoever thou goest.
verse_spoken: Have not I commanded thee? Be strong and of a good courage; be not afraid, neither be thou dismayed:
for the Lord thy God is with thee whithersoever thou goest.
prayer: Heavenly Father, I come to you this morning with a heart that has been holding on to fear.
You told Joshua to be strong and courageous, and today I receive those words for myself.
Where I feel small and unsure, remind me that you are with me wherever I go.
Give me the courage to face the conversations and decisions I have been avoiding.
Silence every voice of doubt that tells me I am not enough.
Help me take the next step in faith, even before I can see the whole path.
When my knees are shaking, let my heart stand firm on your promises.
Strengthen everyone praying with me who is facing something hard today.
Thank you that I never walk into anything alone, because you go before me.
